newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - March 31.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - March 31.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Monday:
* Kuala Lumpur stocks are likely to be adversely affected by measures by the central bank, Bank Negara to curb share and property speculation announced on Friday, analysts said.
* On Friday the benchamrk Composite index of 100 large-cap stocks fell 5.67 to 1,217.64.
* On Sunday Malaysian Airlines announced its plans for a 3.27 billion ringgit cash-raising exercise involving bonus, rights and bond issues.
Bank Negara said on Friday it would restrict banks from lending for the purpose of share speculation.
"People are going to feel that if they don't sell now, those exceeding the loan ratio may be forced to sell in order to meet the new criteria," said Tony Shue, a dealer at Jupiter Securities.
"I see a 10- to 20-point downside potential for the day, but there should be a recovery later," said Shue.
"The two sectors that will be affected most will be banks and property stocks," said Ooi Soon Beng, head of research at Inter-Pacific Securities.
